description.zh-CN:
Resolute Minimal (Vendor)，由 Armbian 社区维护并为 ROCK 5 ITX 打包，适用于 Roobi 自定义源安装。
Lightweight, server-oriented image suited to headless deployments and custom setups.
description.en:
Resolute Minimal (Vendor) is an Armbian image maintained for the ROCK 5 ITX platform and packaged for Roobi.
Lightweight, server-oriented image suited to headless deployments and custom setups.
